# pgmt - PostgreSQL Migration Tool

> Schema-first migration tool for PostgreSQL. Edit schema files like code, automatically track dependencies, generate explicit migrations.

## Quick Start

- Install: `curl -fsSL https://pgmt.dev/install.sh | sh` (or `npm install -g @pgmt/pgmt`, or `cargo install pgmt`)
- Installation: https://pgmt.dev/docs/getting-started/installation
- Quick start: https://pgmt.dev/docs/getting-started/quick-start
- Agent skill: `npx skills add gdpotter/pgmt`

## Key Concepts

- Schema-as-code: Organize PostgreSQL objects in SQL files
- Shadow database: Safe testing environment for migrations
- Dependency tracking: Automatic handling for views/functions
- Explicit migrations: Review generated SQL before deploying
- Multi-section migrations: Per-section transaction modes, timeouts, and retries in one file
- Modules: Partition a schema and deploy different subsets to different databases
- Baselines and provisioning: Build a fresh environment from a baseline plus later migrations
